sections.heading: What happened
sections.text: Tennis player Jodie Burrage received online abuse and death threats following a singles match loss. She shared screenshots of these messages to highlight the prevalence of such harassment, which she notes occurs regardless of match outcomes.

sections.heading: Why it matters
sections.text: Abuse from gamblers is a recurring issue for professional players. Reports indicate that angry gamblers are responsible for a significant portion of verified online abuse. This has led to concerns regarding tournament partnerships with betting firms.

sections.heading: What happens next
sections.text: Players have access to monitoring services like Threat Matrix to assess safety and report offenders. Burrage suggests that requiring identification for social media accounts could improve accountability and reduce the volume of abusive content.

fivew: Professional tennis player Jodie Burrage received online abuse and death threats.
Following a singles match loss in Chennai.
The abuse is frequently driven by angry gamblers betting on tennis matches.

quotes.text: Because we are so used to it - which is really quite sad - I don't fear for my safety.
